title: Nylen's Optimization for Potatos
description: This modpack tries to increase the performance on a potato/low-end laptop/pc so you can have a more enjoyable experience
body:
## Built for Low-End Hardware

Whether you're playing on a potato laptop or an older desktop, this modpack is designed to maximize FPS, reduce stuttering, and provide the smoothest Minecraft experience on low-end hardware.

### Recommended For
-  Potato PCs & laptops
-  Budget gaming PCs
-  Intel HD Graphics & older Intel iGPUs
-  Older NVIDIA GPUs
-  AMD APUs & entry-level AMD GPUs
-  Systems with 4–8 GB of RAM

> **Performance Tip:** For even higher FPS, open the **Render Scale** mod's settings through **Mod Menu** and lower the render scale below **1.0**. Rendering at a lower internal resolution can provide a significant performance boost, especially on weaker hardware.
